best_match.fbbt_term: enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium
best_match.fbbt_definition: A large, polyploid, cuboidal or low-columnar epithelial cell of the adult posterior midgut. It has its nucleus in the middle and a mass of microvilli (brush border) on its apical surface. On its basal side, extensive infoldings of the plasma membrane form a labyrinth which fills the lower half of the cell. It is attached to adjacent enterocytes by smooth septate junctions.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00007037 'enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
